investment_highlights: Africa's most sophisticated financial market. REIT structures available. Cape Town & Sandton among Africa's top addresses. Strong rand-denominated returns plus USD upside.
regulatory_environment: Strong — JSE-listed REITs, FICA compliance, sophisticated property law
risks: Political uncertainty, load-shedding, slow growth vs. Nigeria/Ghana

investment_highlights: World's most liquid real estate market. GBP appreciation benefit for USD investors. London consistently top-3 global city. Strong rental yields in Zone 2-3. Post-Brexit bargains in commercial.
regulatory_environment: World's strongest — FCA regulated, transparent land registry, strong investor protections
risks: High entry prices, stamp duty costs, planning permission complexity

investment_highlights: Largest economy in Africa. 220M+ population. Lagos is Africa's commercial capital. Luxury real estate growing 12% annually. Huge diaspora investor base ($20B+ remittances annually). Off-plan investment delivering 25-40% ROI.
regulatory_environment: Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN), Securities & Exchange Commission (SEC Nigeria), Federal Inland Revenue Service (FIRS)
risks: Currency volatility (Naira depreciation), Inflation, Infrastructure gaps, Regulatory complexity

investment_highlights: Fastest growing economy in West Africa 2026. Oil & gas revenues starting. Dakar is emerging as West Africa's second commercial capital. Tourism real estate booming. Gateway to francophone Africa (8 countries share currency).
regulatory_environment: BCEAO (Central Bank of West African States), CREPMF, APIX (Investment Promotion Agency)
risks: Smaller market size, French language barrier, Limited mortgage financing

investment_highlights: World's most transparent real estate market. Strong legal protection for investors. London remains top global city for real estate. Nigerian & West African diaspora ($3.8B remittances). Stable long-term returns. Easy international investment framework.
regulatory_environment: Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC), Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA)
risks: Post-Brexit regulatory changes, High entry costs, Stamp duty, Market saturation in prime areas

investment_highlights: Most stable democracy in West Africa. English-speaking. Strong legal framework. Accra real estate booming. Gateway to francophone West Africa. High expat demand for quality housing.
regulatory_environment: Bank of Ghana, Ghana SEC, Land Use and Spatial Planning Authority (LUSPA)
risks: Recent IMF bailout, Currency depreciation, Limited mortgage market
